description: This file contains shell functions used during the initialization and setup processes in an embedded Linux environment, likely related to OpenWrt. It defines hooks for boot procedures, functions for pivoting root filesystems, and overlay management, all essential for early system startup.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_start
methods.description: Marks the start of a hook splice operation by setting a specific environment variable.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_finish
methods.description: Completes the hook splice process by updating environment variables based on a list and stored hook values.

methods.name: boot_hook_init
methods.description: Initializes a hook list by appending a new hook name based on the input parameter.

methods.name: boot_hook_add
methods.description: Adds a function to a specified hook's list of functions to execute during boot.

methods.name: boot_hook_shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the first function name from a hook's list.

methods.name: boot_run_hook
methods.description: Iterates through functions registered for a hook and executes them if not run previously.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs a pivot root operation, moving the current root to a new location, and remounts essential filesystems.

methods.name: fopivot
methods.description: Sets up an overlay filesystem on a writable location, then pivots to it, enabling mutable root filesystem.

methods.name: ramoverlay
methods.description: Creates an in-memory overlay filesystem in /tmp/root and uses it for system runtime modifications.
